description: Defines structures and classes related to precoding matrix mapping in a 5G NR MAC layer, including precoding info structures, configuration, and a mapper class.

classes.name: precoding_matrix_mapper
classes.description: Class responsible for mapping MAC precoding information to a precoding matrix index based on configuration.

methods.name: precoding_matrix_mapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mapper with sector ID, number of ports, and configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Overloaded methods mapping different types of MAC precoding info to a matrix index.
